sicherung.extern.ohne: No off-site copy set up yet. If Ablago runs on a NAS with a backup app, the app copies the backup folder. Without one (Raspberry Pi, rented server) a package such as “Backup destination WebDAV” takes every backup to Nextcloud, a NAS or the hosting provider and checks it there.
sicherung.extern.erklaerung: Every backup is first created here in the backup folder; then the package copies it in the background and checks it at the destination. The local backup stays – it is the fast restore; the off-site copy is the protection against fire, theft or disk failure. The key is never at the destination.

loeschkonzept.personendatenText: Which folder types concern a person? Only these can be chosen as the data subject in a data protection request. The purpose per folder type appears in the deletion concept and on the cover sheet of the access request; the storage period comes from archive mode.
loeschkonzept.verantwortlicher: Ablago takes the controller (name and address) from the own organisation:
loeschkonzept.fertig: The deletion concept is complete when these details are there. If something is missing, the document contains a [placeholder] to fill in – that is allowed, you can also fill it in by hand there.

export.im-sicherungsordner: The export folder is inside the backup folder.

notfallblatt.passiert.text: Ablago doesn’t start any more, the device is broken, you can’t get in any more or someone else has to take over? The help page says step by step what to do.
notfallblatt.passiert.qr: Scan with your phone, read there and work on the computer.
notfallblatt.passiert.handbuch: The detailed instructions for restoring are in the administrator manual.
notfallblatt.ui.text: One A4 page with everything you need after a failure: the key for typing in with its fingerprint, the library ID, where the backups are, the link to the help page “Something happened?” with a QR code, and the emergency code in case you lock yourself out. Every new sheet has a new emergency code – the previous one then no longer works. The key is in no backup – keep the sheet in a password safe or printed in a safe place, separate from the device running Ablago.

mail.hinweis.app-passwort: {anbieter} needs an app password, not the normal password. You create it in the account settings of {anbieter}.

mail.hinweis.microsoft: Microsoft is switching off password sign-in for SMTP (Exchange Online end of December 2026). Use sign-in via Microsoft (OAuth).

mail.oauth.app.google: At Google the scope https://mail.google.com/ applies to fetching and sending. Ablago only sends the token to smtp.gmail.com.

sicherung.notfallblatt.benutzt.text: It works only once. Download a new emergency sheet with a new code, print it and destroy the old one.
sicherung.notfallblatt.ohne-code: Your emergency sheet still lacks the emergency code.
sicherung.notfallblatt.ohne-code.text: With it you get back in if you have locked yourself out. Download the emergency sheet again and print it.
notfallzugang.text: Anyone who has locked themselves out gets back in with the emergency code from the emergency sheet via Ablago’s address with /notfall at the end, and sets a new password for an account with administration rights. The code works once; every new emergency sheet brings a new one.
notfallzugang.code: Valid emergency code: on the emergency sheet of {datum}.
notfallzugang.code.keiner: There is no valid emergency code right now. Download an emergency sheet under Encryption – it has a new one.
notfallzugang.internet: Allow emergency access from the internet
notfallzugang.internet.hilfe: Default: only from the home network. It then also works from the internet – for everyone who knows the address and has the code.
notfallzugang.internet.warnung: The emergency access can be reached from the internet. Whoever finds your emergency sheet can get into your library from anywhere with it. Only allow this if you have to reach Ablago without the home network.
notfallzugang.nicht-heimnetz: You aren’t opening Ablago from the home network right now. The emergency access wouldn’t work from here.
notfallzugang.grund.oeffentlich: Ablago sees your address as {code}. If you open Ablago at home via its public name, the request goes via the internet. A local DNS entry that points the name straight to the proxy at home helps.{hilfe}
notfallzugang.grund.proxy: Ablago sees your address as {code}. Your proxy passes the address on in a way Ablago can’t trust. More under “What the proxy tells Ablago”.{hilfe}
notfallzugang.frage: Allow emergency access from the internet?
notfallzugang.frage.text: Then anyone with your emergency sheet gets into your library from anywhere, not only from the home network. Everyone who administers gets an email each time it is used.
absenderbereinigen.das-feld-absender-ist: The “From” field is empty afterwards. The history of each post records what was in it before.
absenderbereinigen.bei-posts-ist-der_one: “From” of one post is now empty.
absenderbereinigen.bis-version-0-99: Up to version 0.99, uploaded post without a sender had the name of whoever created it in the “From” field (then “Sender”; for the intake folder “Intake folder”). Here you find these posts and clear the field. Post from mailboxes and sent emails aren’t included.
absenderbereinigen.nichts-zu-bereinigen-: Nothing to clean up – no post has the name of its creator under “From”.
absenderbereinigen.posts-haben-vermutlic: One post probably has a wrong name under “From”. Remove the tick where it is right after all.
{anzahl} posts probably have a wrong name under “From”. Remove the tick where it is right after all.
anbindung.die-anbindung-steht-in: The connection is in the file {span} and takes precedence – even if {span2} is set in the Compose file. Ablago never shows the password. Below you see long database accesses and what is currently running in the database.
anbindung.database-url-weicht-von: DATABASE_URL differs from this connection and is ignored.
anbindung.entferne-die-variable-aus: {b} Remove the variable from the Compose file to avoid confusion.
anbindung.die-datenbank-laeuft-in: The database runs in this container (dms-komplett).
anbindung.hier-ist-nichts-einzustellen: {b} There is nothing to set here. To move to a database of your own: create a backup here and restore it there – see “Growing and moving” in the administrator manual.
anbindung.ohne-volume.text: {b} Add /data/postgres to the Compose file (or, in your NAS interface, a folder for /data/postgres). Rescue the data first, otherwise Ablago starts with an empty database: {link}
anbindung.ohne-volume.link: Rescue the database from the container (docker compose stop, not down, then docker cp)
anbindung.die-anbindung-steht-in-2: {b} The connection is in the file; you can remove the variable from the Compose file at the next update.
anbindung.die-anbindung-ist-geaendert: The connection has been changed and applies after the restart.
anbindung.im-container-startet-docker: {b} In the container, Docker starts Ablago again right away (restart: unless-stopped).
anbindung.nach-dem-neustart-beginnt: {b} After the restart, setup begins there from scratch (with setup code); the previous data stays in the old database.
anbindung.gespeichert-die-neue-anbindung: Saved. The new connection applies after the restart.
anbindung.uebernehmen-geht-erst-nach: Applying only works after a successful check. The data doesn’t move along – to move to another database, use a {link} and restore it there.
anmeldeschutz.nach-zu-vielen-falschen: After too many wrong passwords Ablago locks the sign-in – per email address and IP, and additionally per IP across all addresses. Locks survive a restart. Your address right now: {code}
anmeldeschutz.je-ip-adresse-ueber: Per IP address, across all email addresses
anmeldeschutz.adressen-oder-netze-z: Addresses or networks, e.g. 192.168.0.0/16 – your home network
anmeldeschutz.angriffsversuche-aus-dem-i: Attack attempts from the internet are normal; locks happen automatically. You can see locked addresses here and in the log at any time.
anmeldeschutz.gerade-ist-keine-adresse: No address is locked right now.
anmeldeschutz.du-hast-die-zwei: You haven’t set up two-factor sign-in yourself yet. If you require it, you keep working now – but set it up at your {b} before it continues. Without your phone, only another administrator or {code} can help then.
anmeldeschutz.jeder-kann-sie-unter: Everyone can set it up for themselves under My account → Security. Here you require it for a role: whoever doesn’t have it yet sets it up at the next sign-in before it continues – whoever is signed in right now keeps working and sees a notice. A passkey fulfils the requirement as well; it is then needed as a second step when signing in with a password. You reset a lost phone under Users.
anmeldeschutz.abmelden-beim-anbieter-moe: , signing out at the provider possible
anmeldeschutz.ohne-abmelden-beim-anbiete: , without signing out at the provider
anmeldeschutz.anmelden-mit-dem-konto: Sign in with the account of an identity provider via OpenID Connect – e.g. Microsoft Entra ID (Microsoft 365), Google Workspace, Keycloak, Authentik or Authelia. Matching is by email address.
anmeldeschutz.beim-anbieter-als-weiterle: Enter at the provider as the redirect URI: {code}{umbruch}After signing out back to: {code2}
anmeldeschutz.gespeichert-leer-lassen-um: saved – leave empty to keep it
anmeldeschutz.sonst-nur-benutzer-die: otherwise only users who already exist in Ablago
anmeldeschutz.unbekannte-adressen-als-ne: Create unknown addresses as new users
anmeldeschutz.als-notzugang-falls-der: as an emergency route in case the provider fails
anmeldeschutz.beim-abmelden-auch-beim: When signing out, also sign out at the provider
anmeldeschutz.schalter.hinweis: On: the sign-in page shows a button for it.
anmeldeschutz.secret-loeschen.text: Ablago forgets the stored client secret. Signing in with this provider only works again once you enter a new one.
ansicht.gespeichert-die-leiste-links: Saved. The sidebar on the left now shows these areas.
ansicht.blende-aus-was-du: Hide what you don’t need. {b} Everything keeps running, links and help still lead there, and notices such as “Backup too old” always appear in the {link}.
ansicht.noch-nicht-eingestellt-bisher: Not set yet – so far you see all areas. At home the template {b} is usually enough, for the self-employed and small businesses the template {b2}.
ansicht.bleibt-aktiv-nur-die: Stays active – only the sidebar doesn’t show it.
archiv.mit-eingeschaltetem-papierkorb: With the bin switched on they land there; otherwise they are gone for good.
archiv.mappen-aus-mappentypen-im: Folders from folder types in archive mode whose retention period has expired. Nothing is deleted automatically – decide yourself what may go.
archiv.liest-jede-gespeicherte-datei: Reads every stored file – older versions too – and compares it with its checksum. That way you notice if a file has been altered on the storage or is missing. The result is also in the log.
aufgaben.aufgaben-entstehen-wenn-eine: Tasks come up when a folder no longer matches the definition, with mentions, from automations (deadlines, reminders, “Post for you”) or by hand. Every folder with an open task appears under “To do” for its recipient.
aufgaben.waehle-links-eine-aufgabe: Choose a task on the left to view its folder or hand the task over.{umbruch}{span}
aufgaben.diese-aufgabe-gibt-es: This task doesn’t exist here (any more) – perhaps it is completed.
aufgaben.die-mappe-laesst-sich: The folder can’t be shown here – according to the permissions you may not read it, or it no longer exists.
benutzer.z-b-als-verantwortliche: e.g. as the people responsible in contracts
benutzer.teil.name: name
benutzer.gerade-aktiv-in-den: {wert} {aktiv} active right now (in the last {AKTIV_MINUTEN} minutes).
benutzer.name: Name
benutzer.aenderst-du-unter-mein: you change it under My account
benutzer.ein-passwort-link-ist: A password link is valid for one hour and works once. The previous password applies until a new one is set.
benutzer.der-benutzer-hat-sein: The user hasn’t set their password yet. A new invitation makes the old one invalid.
benutzer.solange-die-einladung-nicht: As long as the invitation hasn’t been accepted, the user can be deleted.
benutzer.wer-schon-angemeldet-war: Anyone who has already signed in is deactivated instead of deleted – that way links and “created by” are kept.
benutzer.du-siehst-und-bedienst: You then see and use Ablago exactly like {wert}, with this account’s permissions. A warning with the way back stays at the top the whole time. At the next sign-in {wert} learns that and when you worked under this account.
benutzer.deine-eigene-sitzung-endet: Your own session ends; you get back via the warning at the top.
benutzer.aufgaben-die-noch-fuer: ; tasks that still come up for {name} go to {vertreter}
benutzer.ist-deaktiviert-aktivieren-gibt: {name} is deactivated{wert}{wert2}. Activating unlocks the access again; the password still applies.
benutzer.es-ist-kein-vertreter: No stand-in is stored – choose one in the area {bereich}.
benutzer.gib-sie-oben-an: – hand it to {vertreter} in the area {bereich}.
benutzer.der-zugang-ist-sofort: Access is locked immediately; all sessions are ended.
benutzer.die-mappe-bleibt-erhalten: The folder stays; the name appears crossed out everywhere. Links and “created by” stay valid.
benutzer.der-vertreter-bleibt-hinterlegt: The stand-in stays stored and permanently gets what still comes up for {name} (e.g. “doesn’t fit” on folders {name} created).
benutzer.die-einladung-an-wird: The invitation to {email} is withdrawn and the user deleted.
benutzer.der-zugang-ist-sofort-2: Access is locked immediately; all sessions end. Tasks that still come up for {name} go to {vertreter}.
benutzer.danach-reicht-das-passwort: Afterwards the password is enough – if it is required, {name} sets it up again at the next sign-in.
benutzer.gerade-nirgends-angemeldet: Not signed in anywhere right now.
benutzer.er-bekommt-eine-e: They get an email with a link to set their password.
benutzer.kein-e-mail-versand: No email sending set up: after creating, a link appears that you pass on yourself.
benutzer.e-mail-an-ist: The email to {email} has been sent.
benutzer.die-e-mail-an: The email to {email} couldn’t be sent ({mailFehler}).
berechtigungen.wer-mappen-dieses-mappent: Who may create (C), read (R), edit (U – fields and documents), delete (D) folders of this folder type and see passwords (P). In {b} the rules don’t apply.
berechtigungen.gilt-solange-keine-regel: Applies as long as no rule says otherwise. Clicking toggles between ✓ granted and ✗ withdrawn.
berechtigungen.geht-bei-diesem-systemtyp: {RECHTE}: for this system type only via user management or sending
berechtigungen.benutzer-entstehen-und-ve: Users are only created and removed in user management – even in administration mode.
berechtigungen.e-mail-mappen-entstehen: Email folders are only created when sending.
berechtigungen.von-oben-nach-unten: From top to bottom: every applying rule sets its ✓ and ✗; “–” leaves the permission as it is; “Stop” ends the check. Without read, only create has an effect; for notes and tasks, read is enough. Order by dragging the handle or with Alt+↑/↓.
berechtigungen.trifft-die-regel-zu: If the rule applies, the following ones are not checked.
berechtigungen.erst-speichern: Save the folder type first – only saved rules can be copied.
berechtigungen.bedingungen-passten-dort-: {anzahl} condition didn’t fit there (field missing) and is missing.
{anzahl} conditions didn’t fit there (field missing) and are missing.
berechtigungen.in-mappentypen-ans-ende_o: Copied to the end in {anzahl} folder type.{wert}
Copied to the end in {anzahl} folder types.{wert}
berechtigungen.die-regel-kommt-in: The rule “{name}” goes to the end in the chosen folder types. Field conditions are only taken over where the field exists in the same way.
berechtigungen.kopieren-ziele: Folder types the rule is copied to
berechtigungen.rechte-eines-benutzers-an: Try out a user’s permissions on a folder – even with unsaved rules
berechtigungen.gibt-es-sobald-der: Available as soon as the folder type is saved
berechtigungen.welche-rechte-haette-ein: Which permissions would a user have on a particular folder – and which rule decided that? The rules are checked as they are above, even if they aren’t saved yet.
berechtigungen.den-testlauf-gibt-es: The test run is available as soon as the folder type is saved and has folders.
berechtigungen.waehle-benutzer-und-testm: Choose user and test folder – the result appears immediately.
berechtigungen.ist-administrator-fuer-ih: {b} is an administrator – the rules don’t apply to them; they may do everything.
berechtigungen.wirksam-weicht-ab-ohne: Effective differs: without read, only create has an effect; in addition the folder type’s system rules apply.
berechtigungen.je-mappentyp-wie-viele: Per folder type: how many folders they may read according to the saved rules, with a few examples.
betrieb.wie-ablago-e-mails: How Ablago sends emails and at which address it can be reached. Changes apply immediately, without a restart.
betrieb.keine-adresse-gepflegt-links: No address maintained – links use the address of the request.
betrieb.unter-dieser-adresse-oeffnen: Users open Ablago at this address. It is used in the links in emails (invitations, forgot password). If it starts with {span}, sign-in only works via HTTPS.
betrieb.noch-keine-adresse-gepflegt: No address maintained yet. Until then Ablago uses the address it is currently opened with
betrieb.du-rufst-ablago-gerade: You are opening Ablago via HTTP right now, but the address is HTTPS. After the next sign-in this only works via HTTPS. If a reverse proxy runs in front and {span} is set to {span2}, remove the variable.
datenbank.keine-alle-zugriffe-waren: None – all accesses were faster than the threshold.
datenbank.ein-datenbankzugriff-ist-eine: A database access is a method of the data access layer (e.g. {span} for one page of a view) and can comprise several SQL statements. Entries “Request” concern a whole request, split into waiting, database, permissions, preparation and JSON. More details at the same time are in the {link} (module datenbank).
datenbank.jeder-datenbankzugriff-wird-ge: Every database access is timed. Whatever takes longer than the threshold lands in the list and as a warning in the log.
datenbank.der-server-war-zeitweise: The server was busy at times: requests had to wait up to {zahl} before it could process them.
datenbank.verzoegerung-der-ereignisschle: Event loop delay in the last minute: this is how long a request had to wait at most because the server was computing something else. Values under 50 ms are unremarkable. In the timing (developer mode) this wait appears with the other requests as “Line”.
datenbank.abfragen-laufen-schon-laenger_: {anzahl} query has been running for longer than {dauer}.
{anzahl} queries have been running for longer than {dauer}.
datenbank.gerade-keine-abfrage-in: No query in the database right now (except this one). Refreshed every five seconds.
datenschutz.fragt-ein-kunde-mieter: If a customer, tenant or contact asks for their data (access request under Art. 15 GDPR), Ablago collects everything linked to them. You check the list and get a ZIP file with a cover sheet, overview, documents and machine-readable data.
datenschutz.noch-keine-mappe-dieser: No folder of this kind yet.
datenschutz.insgesamt-tippe-um-einzugren: {gesamt} in total – type to narrow down.
datenschutz.die-zip-datei-ist: The ZIP file is then unencrypted. For sending by email a password is recommended that you share separately (e.g. by phone or text message).
datenschutz.nur-ueber-einen-verweis: Only connected via a link of the kind reference: only the fact that the person is mentioned here goes out – without documents, notes and other details. Collecting doesn’t continue via this folder.
datenschutz.mit-dokumenten-notizen-und: – with documents, notes and all details; only if they really concern the person
datenschutz.diese-mappe-ist-auf: This folder can be reached by several routes (circle) – it appears only once in the list
datenschutz.lege-zuerst-unter-fest: First set under {link} which folder types concern a person (e.g. tenant, customer, contact).
datenschutz.aufgabe-fuer-dich-faellig: Task for you, due one month after receipt (Art. 12(3) GDPR)
datenschutz.2-sammeln-alle-mappen: 2. Collect: all folders that belong to the person (links of the kind belonging) – downwards over several levels, upwards only further up. Folders in which the person is only mentioned (reference, e.g. as a contact) appear without their contents. There is deliberately no full-text search – too many mix-ups.
datenschutz.verweise-fuehren-auf-eine_on: One link leads to an already collected folder (↻) – every folder appears only once.
datenschutz.verweise-fuehren-auf-eine_ot: {anzahl} links lead to an already collected folder (↻) – every folder appears only once.
datenschutz.es-gibt-mehr-mappen: There are more folders than shown here (upper limit) – reduce the depth or provide the information in parts.
datenschutz.mit-mehr-ebenen-kaemen: With more levels, further folders would be added.
datenschutz.nur-was-angehakt-ist: Only what is ticked goes into the information. Password fields are never included, older versions of documents aren’t either.{wert}{wert2}{wert3}
datenschutz.enthalten-dokumente-angaben-: {b} If documents contain details about other people (e.g. neighbours in a service charge statement), redact them first: open the document in the library → “Redact”, then “Collect again” here. The redacted version is then suggested instead of the original.
datenschutz.steht-auf-dem-deckblatt: appears on the cover sheet, e.g. tax adviser, caretaker service
datenschutz.teile-das-passwort-getrennt: Share the password separately from the file. It opens with, for example, 7-Zip, WinZip or Keka; the file names are encrypted too (inside is “Auskunft.zip”).
datenschutz.ich-habe-die-auswahl: I have checked the selection – it may go out.
datenschutz.abgewaehlte-notizen-brauchen: An unticked note needs a reason.
datenschutz.wie-soll-sie-zur: How should it reach the person?
datenschutz.ohne-abruf-link-wird: Without a download link the file is deleted after downloading, at the latest on {zeit}. The access request is recorded in the person’s history; it also appears in the list of access requests.
datenschutz.daten-dritter-haengt-auch: Data of third parties? Also attached to: {dritte}{wert}
datenschutz.mappe-in-einem-neuen: Open the folder in a new tab; there “Redact” on the document
datenschutz.anrede-in-unterlagen-fuer: Form of address in documents for third parties
datenschutz.gilt-fuer-alles-was: Applies to everything that goes to the person: cover sheet, overview and README of the access request, the download page and the emails about it. Ablago itself keeps addressing you informally.
demo.seiten-dokumente-in-der: {seiten} pages, {texterkennung} documents in the text recognition queue, documents in {dauer}
demo.ohne-pdftoppm-scans-und: Without pdftoppm: scans and images were created as simple PDFs.
demo.erzeugt-mappen-fuer-die: Creates folders for the existing folder types – with suitable values per field and links to existing folders, optionally with documents. That way you can observe how Ablago behaves with many folders and documents. Demo folders are marked and can be removed together again.
demo.laeuft-im-hintergrund-du: {b} … runs in the background; you can also leave the page.
demo.vertragspartner-vertrag-rechnung-un: Contract partner, contract, invoice and payment with tabs and a few folders. Only possible as long as there are no folder types of your own yet. If there is a storage location (e.g. from an older Library), contracts and invoices get the field “Whereabouts of original documents” and a few storage locations.
demo.bis-50-000-je: up to 50,000 per run, distributed across the folder types; records get more than master data
demo.optional-gleicher-startwert-ergibt: The same start value gives the same data, so that measurements are comparable
demo.nur-fuer-mappentypen-mit: (only for folder types with a documents tab)
demo.bewegst-du-einen-regler: If you move a slider, the others adjust in their previous proportion. Total:
demo.die-texterkennung-vieler-gescannter: Text recognition of many “scanned” PDFs and images takes days rather than hours on a NAS; it then runs in the background. Backups get correspondingly larger.
demo.mit-seiten-zusammen-seiten: , ≈ {dokumente} with ≈ {seiten} pages, together ≈ {groesse}; ≈ {ocrSeiten} pages for text recognition
demo.frei-frei-bleiben-muessen: Free: {groesse}; at least {groesse2} must stay free.
demo.der-speicherplatz-reicht-dafuer: There isn’t enough storage for this. Choose fewer folders, fewer documents or a lighter mix.
demo.ohne-pdftoppm-nur-in: Without pdftoppm (only in development) scans and images are created as simple PDFs.
demo.loescht-alle-demo-mappen: Deletes all {demo} demo folders including their documents, in batches of 1,000. Real folders stay untouched; if a real folder links to a demo folder, nothing is deleted.
designs.farben-und-eigenes-css: Colours and custom CSS of the interface. Each user chooses their theme under My account.
designs.die-vorschau-gilt-schon: The preview already applies to your display; it is saved with “{wert}”.
designs.name: Name
designs.aus-beiden-farben-werden: Shades are derived from both colours (soft backgrounds, readable text on the colour). On dark bases, colours that are too dark are lightened automatically so that they stay readable.
designs.stehen-oben-links-in: Appear at the top left in the header, in the title and icon of the browser tab and – with the default theme – on the sign-in page. For each theme choose a logo that shows up well on its background. They don’t appear in emails.
designs.hoechstens-30-zeichen-leer: at most 30 characters; empty = logo only
designs.ein-logo-laesst-sich: A logo can be uploaded as soon as the theme is saved.
designs.png-jpeg-webp-oder: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, at most 1 MB
designs.fuer-alles-was-farben: For everything colours alone don’t cover. If a CSS makes the interface unusable: append {span} to the address – then the default theme loads without custom CSS.
designs.wer-es-nutzt-bekommt: Whoever uses it gets the default theme.
designs.erst-speichern: Save your changes first – then the design can be set as the default.
eingangsordner.es-ist-kein-eingangsordne: No intake folder is mounted. Mount a folder of your NAS as {code} into the container – see the manual.
eingangsordner.geprueft-nichts-fertiges-: Checked – nothing finished found. A file is only taken over once it no longer changes between two checks.
eingangsordner.jede-fertige-datei-im: Every finished file in the folder {code} becomes a new post (channel “Folder”). A subfolder named after a user’s full e-mail address, e.g. {code2}, enters that user under “To”.
eingangsordner.eine-andere-instanz-von: Another Ablago instance takes over the intake folder; this one waits.
eingangsordner.liegt-genau-diese-datei: – if exactly this file is already in Ablago, no post is created; the file is tidied away as above
eingangsordner.werden-uebernommen-sobald: (taken over as soon as they no longer change)
eingangsordner.abgelehnte-dateien-liegen: Rejected files are in {code}, next to them a text file with the reason.
eingangsordner.ordner-automatisch: Create folders for new users automatically
eingangsordner.ordner-automatisch.text: – one folder named after the e-mail address of each new person; if the address changes, Ablago renames it too
eingangsordner.warnen.text: All files under /eingang count, including erledigt/ and fehler/. 0 turns a warning off.
eingangsordner.personen.text: A folder named after a user’s full e-mail address, e.g. {code}, enters that user under “To” – also for folders below it, such as the scanner’s date folders. Name, first name or the part before the @ do not count. Files taken over move to {code2}.
eingangsordner.personen.leserecht: “To” is not a read permission: who may see the post is set by the permissions of the folder type Post. The manual explains how to turn “To” into a read permission.
eingangsordner.personen.ohne_one: {anzahl} active user has no folder yet.
eingangsordner.personen.ohne_other: {anzahl} active users have no folder yet.
eingangsordner.personen.alle: All active users have a folder.
eingangsordner.ohne-person: Folder “{ordner}” does not belong to any user.
eingangsordner.ohne-person.text: Post from it arrives without “To”. Only a folder named after a user’s full e-mail address sets “To” – rename it or create the folders per person.
eingangsordner.umbenennen: Folder “{alt}” could not be renamed to “{neu}”.
eingangsordner.umbenennen.text: The person’s e-mail address has changed. Rename the folder on the NAS by hand, otherwise post from it arrives without “To”.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.noch-nicht: Not calculated yet – comes with the next check.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.text: All files under /eingang per folder, including erledigt/ and fehler/. Calculated {zeit}; Ablago recalculates at most every five minutes, “Check now” at once.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.gekuerzt: Very many folders: not all are listed, but the figures still count them.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.zu-tief_one: {anzahl} file lies deeper than 5 levels and is not taken over.
eingangsordner.ueberwachung.zu-tief_othe: {anzahl} files lie deeper than 5 levels and are not taken over.

wiederherstellung.damit-niemand-gleichze: {b}, so nobody works at the same time.
zustellen.die-person-laedt-die: The person downloads the file on a plain page of your Ablago – traceable, with an expiry date. They get the code by a different route.
zustellen.als-anhang-verschluesselt-das: As an attachment, encrypted. You share the password separately (phone, letter).
zustellen.nur-fuer-auskuenfte-mit: Only for access requests with a password – create it again with a password for this.
zustellen.der-bisherige-link-dieser: This access request’s previous link then stops working – and so does its access code.
zustellen.ist-dein-ablago-aus: Can your Ablago be reached from the internet?
zustellen.die-adresse-sieht-nach: {b} The address {wert} looks like a home network. The person can only open the link if your Ablago can be reached from outside (reverse proxy, tunnel or hosting). Otherwise use email. You set the address under {link}.
zustellen.link-per-e-mail: Link sent by email to {b} (without code).
zustellen.nicht-per-e-mail: Not sent by email – copy the link and send it yourself.
zustellen.teile-den-abrufcode-auf: Share the access code by a different route
zustellen.per-brief-telefon-oder: {b} – by letter, phone or text message, never in the same email as the link. It’s only shown now; if it gets lost, create a new link.
zustellen.nur-fuer-den-nachweis: only for the record in the history; ticked, they get the link (without code)
zustellen.nur-fuer-den-nachweis-2: only for the record in the history; sending email isn’t set up
zustellen.von-ablago-erzeugen-empfohlen: Generated by Ablago (recommended) – 8 characters, only visible now
zustellen.eigener-code-den-nur: A code of your own that only the person knows – e.g. the contract number
zustellen.eine-kundennummer-allein-ist: A customer number on its own is weak
zustellen.mindestens-zeichen-er-wird: At least {CODE_EIGEN_MIN} characters. It is shown exactly as you enter it. Upper and lower case, spaces and hyphens don’t matter when downloading – “KD-12345” and “kd12345” count as the same. {b} – it’s often printed on letters and invoices.
zustellen.nach-falschen-codes-ist: After {LINK_FEHLVERSUCHE_MAX} wrong codes the link is locked; on top of that the sign-in protection per internet connection applies.
zustellen.gesendet-an-teile-jetzt: Sent to {an}. Now share the password by a different route.
zustellen.mit-ist-die-auskunft: At {groesse} the access request is too large for an email. Use the download link.
zustellen.viele-mailserver-nehmen-nur: {groesse} – many mail servers only accept 10 to 25 MB. If the email doesn’t arrive, use the download link.
zustellen.schreib-das-passwort-nicht: Don’t write the password in it.
zustellen.das-passwort-steht-nicht: The password isn’t in the email
zustellen.anhang-mit-passwort-verschlues: Attachment: {groesse}, encrypted with a password (AES-256). {b} – share it by phone, text message or letter.
zustellen.der-link-gilt-sofort: The link stops working immediately. The entry stays as a record; the ZIP file is deleted after the usual 7 days.

bereich.sprachen.name: Languages
bereich.sprachen.wann: If English or another language is also spoken in your library.
sprachen.gespeichert: Saved. Anyone who switches language sees it after the next reload.
sprachen.einleitung: Set which languages exist in your library. Everyone picks their language in My account from these.
sprachen.standard.hinweis: For everyone who hasn’t chosen one, before sign-in and for emails to them.
sprachen.weitere.text: Other languages come as language packs from the package catalogue.
sprachen.rueckfall: If a text is missing in a language, it appears in English, otherwise in German.
sprachen.paket.name: {name} {version}
sprachen.pakete.holen: Language packages in the package catalogue
pakete.sprache.vorschau: Language package for {sprache}: texts only, no code. Translation {prozent} % complete ({vorhanden} of {gesamt} texts), made for Ablago {ablago}. Anything missing appears in English.
pakete.sprache.beschriftungen: Brings labels for these packages: {pakete}. They go on their folder types and views where nothing is there in this language yet.
pakete.sprache.erlauben: After installing, you allow the language under Workbench → Languages.
uebersetzen.einleitung: With a translation package, everyone can read letters, notes and fields in another language in their own at the press of a button. Only the original is ever stored.
uebersetzen.kein-paket: This needs a package with the permission “Translate content”, for example from the package catalogue. Without a package there is no button.
uebersetzen.automatisch: Automatic – a package that translates on the device
uebersetzen.keins-wirksam: No package is translating right now: it isn’t running yet, or it needs the network and hasn’t been chosen explicitly.
uebersetzen.aus: Switched off – nobody sees the button.
uebersetzen.abfluss.text: “{paket}” doesn’t translate on the device: every text someone has translated is sent to {ziele}. Whoever translates sees this on the result.
bereich.nutzung.name: Use
bereich.nutzung.wann: whether the Library is also used for work – folder types then show their work-related fields and sections
nutzung.einleitung: What this Library is used for. Folder types can show fields and sections depending on it (“Show if …”) – so a folder type stays simple in a purely private Library and can still do everything in a business.
nutzung.beruflich: The Library is also used for work
nutzung.beruflich.hinweis: For example when self-employed, in a club or in a business. Applies to the whole Library, not per person.
nutzung.ordnung: Hiding is for tidiness, not protection: values of hidden fields stay saved and appear in the API, exports and data access requests. Who may see what is set by the permissions.
nutzung.vorlage: Matching Workbench template: {vorlage}. It follows the attribute as long as nobody has adjusted the sidebar.
nutzung.gespeichert: Saved. Folders now show what belongs to this setting.
bereich.organisation.name: Own organisation
bereich.organisation.wann: name, address and controllers of your own business – kept at the organisation in the Library
organisation.einleitung: You keep name, address, contact and the controllers under the GDPR once – at the organisation in the Library that carries the attribute “own organisation”. Ablago takes them from there for data protection requests and the deletion concept.
organisation.ohne-angaben: No details yet – enter name, address and contact in the Library.
organisation.verantwortlicher-unbekannt: the folder referred to no longer exists
organisation.verwendung.auskunft: Data protection requests: sender on the cover sheet and in the email to the person
organisation.verwendung.erkennung: Recognition: the own organisation is never the sender of incoming post
organisation.verwendung.briefkopf: Letters from text templates: letterhead, unless the letter is for a particular person
organisation.verwendung.anzeige: Folder type {typ}: “Show if …” refers to an own organisation
organisation.nur-liste: For this Ablago reads only name, address, email, phone, controller and data protection officer – even if you may not see the folder otherwise. Changes are only possible in the Library with your rights.
organisation.keine-rechtsberatung: No legal advice: whether and whom you must name as controller or data protection officer should be checked by an expert if in doubt.
organisation.ohne-basis: The attribute “own organisation” comes with the package Basis from version 1.7.0. Install or update it under Packages.
organisation.keine: No own organisation yet. Open your business’s organisation in the Library (or create it) and tick “{feld}” – only someone managing the own organisation may do so.
organisation.bitte-waehlen: There are several own organisations – please choose one, otherwise the controller on requests stays empty.
organisation.uebernommen: The own organisation has been created. Check the details in the Library.
organisation.bisher.text: Until now the controller was a text in the request settings. Ablago keeps using it until there is an own organisation – you can take it over as own organisation.
organisation.bisher.ersetzt: This entry no longer applies – Ablago now uses the own organisation.
organisation.rollen.text: The attribute is changed by whoever may manage this area in administration mode. In addition, anyone with one of these roles may change it – provided they may edit the organisation.
organisation.notiz.merkmal-aus: no longer marked as own organisation
datenschutz.verantwortlicher-organisatio: Controller: name and address come from the own organisation – {link}.
anmeldeschutz.passkey.text: Everyone can add passkeys under My account → Security and use them to sign in without a password. Here you can require them per role: anyone who has none adds one after their next sign-in; when signing in with a password it is then needed as a second step.
anmeldeschutz.passkey.admin: Require for everyone who may administer
anmeldeschutz.passkey.hinweis: Anyone who loses their passkey and has no code app needs you: Users → person → reset passkeys.
anmeldeschutz.passkey.selbst: No passkey of your own yet?
anmeldeschutz.passkey.selbst.text: You have no passkey yet. After your next sign-in you must add one before you can continue.
betrieb.passkeys: Passkeys only work for the name they were created under. With a different name (domain), existing passkeys no longer fit – everyone then signs in with their password and adds new ones.
benutzer.passkeys.frage.text: {name} then signs in with the password and can add new passkeys. Useful if a device is lost.
anmeldeschutz.passkey.ohne-adresse: The passkey requirement is on, but Ablago no longer has a maintained address starting with https://. The requirement still applies: anyone affected can only reach My account. Enter the address again or switch the requirement off.
anmeldeschutz.passkey.gilt-fuer: The requirement applies to passkeys at {adresse}. Via other addresses (e.g. the IP address) nobody gets in without this passkey.
betrieb.passkey-pflicht: Passkeys are required (sign-in protection). Without an address starting with https:// the requirement still applies but can no longer be fulfilled: those affected can then only reach My account.
